summary.scope: Intervention catalog (81 items, app/data/bundle-la.b64.txt -> catalog; shared by all bundles), recommendation rows in 639 county bundles (OC + 637 national + LA catalog), plans/profit, research/*.csv, pipeline/engine.py

class_definition.V: effect and cost both confirmed against a fetched source
class_definition.P: one of effect/cost confirmed (or, for no-$-effect items, cost cited to a named public document)
class_definition.U: neither confirmed, source not found, irreproducible, or self-labelled unverified
